subject: Discovery recap & trial onboarding plan
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laurie Chen <laurie@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & trial onboarding plan

Hi Laurie — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap of the core points we captured, and a proposed lightweight onramp to a 30-day pilot so we can prove value quickly. Please skim and confirm any corrections.

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: high volume of ambiguous support tickets and long TTR for Tier 1 triage, plus a growing backlog of policy exceptions.
- Goal: reduce manual triage time (avg handle time) by 40% on prioritized use cases; maintain or improve precision over current rules/heuristics.

Proposed 30-day pilot (high level)
- Scope: 3 priority flows — ticket triage (incoming classification), suggested replies (templates), and policy-flagging for edge cases.
- Success metrics: latency <= 350ms median for generation; classification precision >= 0.85; triage throughput 2x current baseline for sampled window.
- Prompt & eval plan: we’ll start with the prompt set you shared today (sample v1) and run daily evals against a 500-item labeled holdout. Primary metrics: precision/recall, hallucination rate (manual spot-check), and latency.
- Owners: Novapulse product lead: Laurie Chen (we’ll need a technical owner for infra). Redwood: Karthik (sales), Ben (CS), Hannah (ops).
- Timeline: Kickoff week of March 1, environment readiness (network + credentials) by Mar 2, pilot run Mar 3–Apr 1, week-of-Apr-5 retrospective.

Access & setup asks (technical)
1) Provide a sample S3 bucket/path with ~1k representative tickets (anonymized).
2) Add a technical contact for VPC/IAM work (we’ll need IAM-ish role or temporary API key for initial run).
3) Confirm any egress restrictions; see attached network_requirements.pdf.
4) If SOC2 evidence is required we’ll share our questionnaire link (attached stub).

Attachments: pilot_scope_template.xlsx (proposed activities & owners), network_requirements.pdf, SOC2 questionnaire link (stub).

Next steps / asks for Novapulse
- Confirm technical owner and preferred kickoff date (we suggested Tues, Mar 2 or Wed, Mar 3).
- Upload sample dataset to S3 and share path + IAM contact.
- Quick confirmation on success metrics above or propose edits.

I’ll follow up with a calendar hold for a 30–45min kickoff once you confirm availability. Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Laurie Chen <laurie@novapulse.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & trial onboarding plan

Thanks Hannah — this looks right and very helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We agree on the three priority flows. For the labeled holdout, we have ~650 labeled tickets ready; we can expand to 1k by next week. We will upload a sanitized sample to S3 by end of day Thursday (I’ll share the path once the SRE team finishes scrub).
- Technical owner: Ivan Petrov (cc’d). He will own VPC peering / IAM. Ivan, can you confirm whether Novapulse will allow temporary API keys or if we need to do VPC peering first?
- SOC2: we’ll need the questionnaire link; if you can share the stub that’s fine. Our security team might also want to run a short questionnaire before any data transfer.
- Kickoff: Wednesday, Mar 3 works best for our team at 10:00am PT. If that works on your side we’ll lock it.

Appreciate the clear success criteria — I’ll circle back after internal confirmation of the dataset scrub.

Onwards,
Laurie
Director, Product — Novapulse
laurie@novapulse.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & trial onboarding plan — quick ops notes

Looping Rohan (runtime lead) so he can scope the infra piece. Quick internal checklist before we lock the kickoff: 

- Rohan: can you confirm estimated setup time for a Dedicated trial slot vs hosted sandbox? We should recommend hosted sandbox first to move faster unless Novapulse requires VPC.
- Network: if Novapulse needs VPC peering, we’ll need the CIDR ranges + contact ETA. See network_requirements.pdf for the standard list.
- Data: confirm that the sample S3 bucket will be accessible via short-lived creds — if not, we’ll run with a redact-and-pull flow.
- Prompt/eval: Ben — can you prepare a 500-item eval harness (precision/recall + hallucination check) and a small pilot dashboard for live metrics? Target: have harness ready by Mon, Mar 1.

If all good, I’ll accept the Mar 3 kickoff proposed by Laurie and send an invite for 10:00am PT. We’ll include Rohan, Ben, a CS engineer, and the success metric owner from our side.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Laurie Chen <laurie@novapulse.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap & trial onboarding plan

Thanks all — Mar 3, 10:00am PT is confirmed on our side. Ivan says we can provide a short-lived IAM role for initial upload and will confirm the S3 path by Thursday EOD. I’ve also attached a copy of our internal SOC2 checklist — I’ll share with our security folks and loop Emily (cc) for coordination.

We’ll see you on Mar 3. For the kickoff agenda please include: goals re-confirmation, data handoff steps, quick prompt walk-through, and success metric alignment. 

Laurie
